steps_taught.name: Upward Finger Roll

steps_taught.name: Downward Finger Roll

quotes.text: Finger rolls are the most important move in gloving.
Do not rush them, please, for your own sake.
The key to having clean finger rolls is to make sure your pinkies are connected.
